notes.title: New Update 1.0.0.8
notes.content:
We implement some changes: 
-10-15% better perfomance 
-autosave 
-boxes can be open by shotgun 
-more infos with missions 
-repair mission with Geiger counter 
-add resolution support for 1280x1024,2560x1080, 2560x1440 
-fix for visibility with building objects 
-more monster at night, less animals at days 
-more damage for monster 
-level up info 
-fix for menu 
-added butterfly 
-better compression for textures 
-fix for building in spaceship 
-better animals reaction
